title: Whole steps away from zero
description: A marker sits offset units from the origin (negative means to the left). It moves in whole steps of step units; count only the complete steps between the origin and the marker, counting a step to the left as negative. This is offset divided by step, rounded toward zero: offset 7 with step 3 gives 2, offset -7 with step 3 gives -2. step is positive.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states truncation toward zero in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
